rules.hand_ranks_body:
Single, pair, triple, straight, flush, full house, four of a kind, straight flush.
Ranks: 3-10, J, Q, K, A, 2 (2 is highest).
Suits: ♣ < ♦ < ♥ < ♠ (suit breaks ties).
rules.play_body:
On your turn play **1 / 2 / 3 / 5 cards** as a legal hand, or **Pass**.
Your play must **beat** the last one (same hand type); on an empty table any legal hand can lead.
If everyone passes, the table clears and the last player to play leads again.
rules.table_body:

**Free opener**: 3♦ is not required; the host can switch this in the lobby dropdown.

tower.notices:
• Each level has **2 🟦 safe tiles** and **1 🌵 cactus** at random
• Hitting the cactus = **game over, you lose the whole bet**
• On a safe tile you can **climb on** (higher multiplier) or **cash out** (lock in the current multiplier)
• Multipliers: L1 x1.4 → L2 x1.8 → L3 x2.2 → L4 x2.6 → L5 x3.0
• Reaching the top cashes out automatically
